findings.problem: For down with movement downward, as in come down, herunter and nach unten are equally right answers, and the hint does not rule them out.
findings.fix: hint: movement downward, the short everyday word, as in come down (not herunter or nach unten)

back.target: down (moving downward; colloquial short form of herunter/hinunter)

note: Austrian and Swiss dialect words (aba/obi, abe) differ, but standard speech there also uses runter, so a null regional is fine.
